hints.tr: İki kümeyi kur: `x, y = char_ngrams(a, n), char_ngrams(b, n)`.
hints.en: Build both sets: `x, y = char_ngrams(a, n), char_ngrams(b, n)`.

hints.tr: Kesişim `x & y`, birleşim `x | y`; `round(len(x & y) / len(x | y), 2)`.
hints.en: Intersection `x & y`, union `x | y`; `round(len(x & y) / len(x | y), 2)`.
